node: Solid rocket motor energetics and missile-production inputs
summary: Expanded the public-market universe around solid rocket motor energetics and missile-production inputs with a two-lane lens. Reference lane is represented by L3Harris as a demand-path anchor in the SRM prime/subprime layer. Underfollowed discovery lane prioritizes companies that sit one step below obvious missile primes: NewMarket via AMPAC ammonium perchlorate, Karman via SRM nozzles and qualified propulsion components, and Ducommun via missile-defense electronics/structures. The strongest direct chokepoint evidence is NEU/AMPAC; KRMN has direct SRM nozzle capacity evidence; DCO is a broader missile-production input hypothesis needing program-level mapping.
